answers.core: I'm sure it's possible to do this with an import plugin as well, but I believe it's basic enough that it should be in core. Plugins shouldn't be necessary for usability of core features.
answers.workaround: It might be possible to do this with an import script, but I don't think that should be necessary. This is about improving the default workflow for MeshLibrary and by extension GridMap, which are core features.

title: Allow importing scenes (glTF etc) as MeshLibraries
